audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Leviticus / Vayiqra childbirth purification text tradition, draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for childbirth blood/purification, male/female birth durations, circumcision on eighth day, offerings, and poverty provision. Strong anti-body-shame safeguards required.

familiar.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

verses.restored: Speak to children of Israel, saying: When a woman conceives seed and bears a male, she shall be unclean seven days; as in days of impurity of her menstruation she shall be unclean.

familiar.text: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a woman have conceived seed, and born a man child: then she shall be unclean seven days; according to the days of the separation for her infirmity shall she be unclean.

verses.restored: On eighth day flesh of his foreskin shall be circumcised.

familiar.text: And in the eighth day the flesh of his foreskin shall be circumcised.

verses.restored: Thirty-three days she shall remain in bloods of purification; she shall not touch any holy thing and shall not come into sanctuary until days of her purification are fulfilled.

familiar.text: And she shall then continue in the blood of her purifying three and thirty days; she shall touch no hallowed thing, nor come into the sanctuary, until the days of her purifying be fulfilled.

verses.restored: If she bears a female, she shall be unclean two weeks as in her menstruation, and sixty-six days she shall remain over bloods of purification.

familiar.text: But if she bear a maid child, then she shall be unclean two weeks, as in her separation: and she shall continue in the blood of her purifying threescore and six days.

verses.restored: When days of her purification are fulfilled, for son or for daughter, she shall bring lamb, son of a year, for burnt offering, and son of pigeon or turtledove for sin/purification offering to entrance of tent of meeting, to priest.

familiar.text: And when the days of her purifying are fulfilled, for a son, or for a daughter, she shall bring a lamb of the first year for a burnt offering, and a young pigeon, or a turtledove, for a sin offering, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, unto the priest:

verses.restored: He shall bring it near before YHWH and make atonement/covering for her, and she shall be clean from flow/source of her bloods. This is Torah/instruction for one giving birth, for male or female.

familiar.text: Who shall offer it before the LORD, and make an atonement for her; and she shall be cleansed from the issue of her blood. This is the law for her that hath born a male or a female.

verses.restored: If her hand does not find enough for lamb, she shall take two turtledoves or two sons of pigeon, one for burnt offering and one for sin/purification offering; priest shall make atonement/covering for her, and she shall be clean.

familiar.text: And if she be not able to bring a lamb, then she shall bring two turtles, or two young pigeons; the one for the burnt offering, and the other for a sin offering: and the priest shall make an atonement for her, and she shall be clean.

translation_notes: Childbirth impurity is ritual-state language tied to blood/life and sanctuary approach, not moral fault, sexual shame, or disgust toward mother or baby.
Bloods of purification should be preserved; it does not mean the mother sinned by giving birth.
Different durations for male/female birth require historical/source and gender-ethics audit; do not explain away too quickly.
Bird offering option protects access for poor mothers.
safety_note: Do not use Leviticus 12 to shame pregnancy, birth, menstruation, postpartum bodies, women, girls, or mothers. The chapter is ancient ritual-state instruction around birth and sanctuary timing, with an accessible offering for poverty.
